decisions.reason: Focus unit has 澶州節度使; 澶州 is Chan, not Bian (汴). The proposed replacement correctly restores Rong as Military Commissioner of Chan.
The literal likewise mistranslates 澶州 as Bian prefecture; Chan prefecture matches the Chinese toponym.
劉遂凝 romanizes as Liu Suining; Suening omits the medial i and is a misspelling of the given name.
The literal line repeats the same Suening misspelling for 劉遂凝; Suining is the correct form.
秘書監 is the Palace Library directorate, distinct from the Secretariat (中書); the repair correctly retitles Zhao Shangjiao's prior office.
